entries.text: Fixed result validation rejecting a passed run whose throughput queries ran after the refresh functions: row counts skipped because the data was refreshed, or accepted within a tolerance or range, no longer contradict a passed summary, while skips without a documented reason still do and a run whose row counts were all skipped is now summarised as not validated.
Fixed TPC-H refresh functions failing on CedarDB with an active-transaction error, which made official power and throughput runs fail there; CedarDB now runs refresh functions.
